Ontology for modeling the three following neuromuscular diseases : OPMD, Congenital myopathies and Congenital myastenic syndroms. It aims to be also an ontology for building the PROMOT project relational database.

Additional acknowledgements:
	- Thomas Bongibault MSc, Imagine Institute
	- Silvia Cerezo Corredera MD, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3391-9772

	- Marc Vincent PhD, Imagine Institute, https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6921-8161
More about PROMOT initiative at https://www.promotinitiative.com/

definition.val: A type of weakness of the axial muscles (i.e., of the muscles of the head and neck, vertebral column, and intercostal muscles) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of the strength of the axial muscles with repetitive muscle actions.
